findings: CVE.org CVE-2026-59948 is PUBLISHED; GHSA-499r-g7pc-vmp9 is a live reviewed GitHub advisory (withdrawn_at null). Real CWE-22 path-traversal arbitrary write via invalid package names from untrusted Composer repositories.

Atomic BIC is e03983697a9e5ff674fc3819cef857e68df6f59f (parent 2475ce47e4c76bb8924d74f2d859ccd8a59e7b2b): first public ComposerRepository+installer+GitDownloader chain using repository-controlled rev['name'] as the vendor clone/archive destination.
Immediate parent tree lacks ComposerRepository, GitDownloader, LibraryInstaller, and InstallCommand, so the mechanism is absent before the BIC.

Pre-fix surviving sink is LibraryInstaller::getInstallPath concatenating vendorDir with getPrettyName(); pre-fix ComposerRepository still constructs packages with non-validating ArrayLoader. Those are refactors of the 2011 first-write, not a later BIC.

Direct fixes 502c6c4f699802d9cf464728b3e8a95674f919a0 (contained by 2.10.2, not 2.10.1) and c50b1efd13ebd73f6dca19b31424c5a02bf93cc1 (contained by 2.2.29, not 2.2.28) add validatePackage on solver results.
